title: Call-Level Revision Contracts for LLM-Authored Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.06967v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Durable execution engines replay a recorded history and do not compare activity payloads. When a model repairs a workflow that failed partway through, it must either pay again for calls that succeeded or accept a recorded result whose payload changed. We define a revision contract for workflows whose orchestration code is written by a model. Each capability call carries a structural identity built from its callsite, its fanout position, and its occurrence count, and the identity stays stable under rewrites that leave the call in place, so committed identities form a frozen prefix. The frozen unit is the call expression, and the surrounding code stays writable. A static gate rejects a rewrite that would change a committed call before a container starts. A runtime digest stops a changed payload at a committed identity, and an occurrence ledger names a repeated paid payload. Under three assumptions, a candidate the gate accepts replays ever

translated_title: 面向LLM编写工作流的调用级修订契约
translated_abstract: 持久化执行引擎通过重放已记录的历史来运行，且不会比较活动负载。当模型修复一个在中途失败的工作流时，它要么必须为已经成功的调用再次付费，要么接受一个负载已被更改的记录结果。我们为编排代码由模型编写的工作流定义了一种修订契约。每个能力调用都携带一个由其调用位置、扇出位置和出现次数构成的结构化标识，且该标识在保持调用位置不变的改写下保持稳定，因此已提交的标识构成一个冻结前缀。冻结单元是调用表达式本身，而周围的代码保持可写。静态门控会在容器启动之前拒绝任何会改变已提交调用的改写；运行时摘要会在已提交标识处拦截被更改的负载；出现账本则用于标记重复付费的负载。在三个假设条件下，门控所接受的候选项可重放已记录的历史……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文为LLM编写的工作流提出了调用级修订契约，通过为每个调用赋予稳定的结构化标识以构成冻结前缀，并配合静态门控、运行时摘要和出现账本三重机制，解决了模型修复失败工作流时重复付费或接受已变更负载的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes call-level revision contracts for LLM-authored workflows, where each call carries a stable structural identity forming a frozen prefix, enforced via a static gate, runtime digest, and occurrence ledger to prevent double-paying for succeeded calls or accepting changed payloads during workflow repair.
